questions.q: What does the location flexfield on an asset record?
options: The asset's depreciation method
Where the asset physically sits, typically from broad to specific segments
The vendor who sold the asset
The asset's category book
questions.explain: The location flexfield is a hierarchical, configurable structure (country, state, city, building, floor, etc.) recording where an asset physically sits.

questions.q: Which real business need does accurate asset location data support?
options: Property tax reporting and physical inventory audits
Setting the General Ledger's functional currency
Determining a vendor's payment terms
Calculating sales tax on customer invoices
questions.explain: Location data is used to file property tax correctly by jurisdiction and to verify, during a physical audit, that assets are actually where the books say.

questions.q: What is an asset key flexfield used for?
options: Recording the asset's depreciation life
Identifying or grouping assets by something other than category or location, such as a project or grant
Storing the asset's retirement date
Replacing the need for an asset category
questions.explain: A key flexfield is a separate, optional structure for identifying assets by criteria category and location don't cover, like project or grant funding.

questions.q: Does every Oracle Fusion Assets implementation need to configure an asset key flexfield?
options: Yes, it's required for every asset
No, it's optional and only needed when category and location can't answer a reporting question
Yes, but only for tax books
No, key flexfields were removed from Oracle Fusion Cloud
questions.explain: A company whose category and location structure already answers every reporting question it has may never need to turn on an asset key flexfield.

questions.q: Why is flexfield segment design treated as a one-time decision worth getting right upfront?
options: Flexfields cannot be used for reporting
Changing the segment structure after many assets already reference it is disruptive
Oracle Fusion only allows one flexfield to be created per company, ever
Flexfields automatically reconfigure themselves each fiscal year
questions.explain: Because the segment structure is fixed once assets start referencing it, changing it later after thousands of assets exist is disruptive, so it's worth basing it on real requirements from the start.
